name: Morgan Martinez
prior_offices: Washakie County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Morgan Martinez is a Washakie County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists her as a member. The Northern Wyoming News reported that she and Terrence Wolf won the August 2026 Republican nominations and advanced to the general election.
